name: Yamada Tarou
source:
A man who approaches Annerose and her friends, who may be friend or foe.
He uses appropriate pseudonyms such as John Smith or Alan Smithee, depending on his mood at the time.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=680360]Getchu[/url]]
